newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo breaks back below 100 on mark.
newsitem.headline: Escudo breaks back below 100 on mark.

text.p: The escudo was strengthening against the mark on Monday, breaking back below 100 to the German currency on Monday.

The Portuguese unit, which slipped against the mark last week as the peseta lost ground, was trading at 99.85/90 to the mark at 1205 GMT. The currency opened at 100.01/06 after closing on Friday at 100.12/17.

Dealers said that the currency could hold below the psychological barrier of 100 after the Bank of Portugal showed last week that it was determined to protect the currency. The slight weakness of the escudo was one reason, dealers say, why the Bank did not cut key interest rates as expected last Friday.
